selectedWork.title: Selected Work
selectedWork.subtitle: A few projects I've worked on recently

items.name: ShopM
items.description: Multi-store commercial management system (SaaS) allowing different merchants to manage one or several independent stores: employees, inventory, stock, and checkout/point of sale.
items.problem: Lack of an accessible tool enabling independent merchants to digitize and centralize the management of their store(s), regardless of number or ownership.
items.impact: Simplifies merchants' daily operations, reduces stock errors, and improves sales and employee tracking, store by store.

items.name: Budget_App
items.description: Mobile app for personal budget tracking to manage finances and monthly expenses.
items.problem: Lack of visibility into spending habits, making it difficult to manage a monthly budget.
items.impact: Helps users better control their finances and reduce unnecessary spending through clear, regular tracking.

items.name: Empreintes
items.description: Showcase and e-commerce website for Empreintes, a Beninese leather goods brand (bags, pouches, shoes, sandals) locally handcrafted for men and women.
items.problem: Lack of an online platform for the brand to share its story, vision, and identity, while giving customers direct access to the catalog and ordering process.
items.impact: Strengthens the brand's visibility and credibility through an experience true to its visual identity, while making product discovery and online ordering easier.

items.name: Clɔ̌ avɔ̌
items.description: Mobile web/app connecting users with laundresses for at-home laundry service (billed per kilo) and house or office cleaning, at competitive prices. (Project currently in development)
items.problem: Lack of a simple, reliable solution for booking at-home laundry or cleaning services with clear, accessible pricing.
items.impact: Makes on-demand laundry and cleaning services more accessible, while offering laundresses and service providers a flexible source of income.

items.description: Design and development of the showcase/e-commerce website for this Beninese leather goods brand. Stack: React, TypeScript, Django, PostgreSQL.
Development of a PWA app connecting users with laundresses for at-home laundry and house/office cleaning services. Stack: React, TypeScript, Django.
As creator and owner of the ShopM SaaS, set up a dedicated profile for Cuisine Store under an annual subscription plan, for managing their store (inventory, stock, checkout, employees).
Professional internship at a Beninese startup specializing in HR and payroll management. Contributed to fullstack development of the platform.
Paired development of a teacher evaluation software as part of the graduation thesis, now used to replace Google Forms, which lacked centralization for decision-making.
